title: Close and pilot confirmation
situation: The buyer committed on the call and there are steps to confirm.
notes: The spec routes this on buying_stage stage value committed. Bundle claims carry the stage as text plus a basis, and the enum value travels only when the extractor writes it onto the claim, so the trigger accepts either that value or an objection the buyer accepted on this call.
